import importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
r=Path('experiments/results/imu_dr_readme_and_retrieval')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('oracle_diagnostic',r/'diagnose_reference_objective.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
source=np.array([[0.,0.,0.],[2.,0.,0.],[0.,3.,1.]])
t=np.eye(4);t[:3,3]=[.3,-.2,.1]
good=m.residuals(source,source+t[:3,3],t,1.)
assert all(v['support_fraction']==1 and v['clipped_mean_squared_m2']<1e-20 for v in good.values())
bad=m.residuals(source,source+100,np.eye(4),1.)
assert all(v['support_fraction']==0 and v['supported_rmse_m'] is None and v['clipped_mean_squared_m2']==1 for v in bad.values())
p=json.loads((r/'oracle_accounted_diagnostic.json').read_text())
assert p['oracle_diagnostic_only'] and not p['included_in_benchmark_success_count']
assert len(p['cases'])==4 and sum(x['frame_gate_passed'] for x in p['cases'])==2
for row in p['cases']:
 if not row['frame_gate_passed']:assert row['oracle_skipped'] and 'diagnostics' not in row
commands=[json.loads((r/name).read_text())['exit_code'] for name in ['oracle_command.json','oracle_accounted_command.json']]
assert commands==[1,1]
result={'analytic_residual_controls_valid':True,'case_accounting_valid':True,'original_failed_gate_and_skipped_cases_preserved':True,'oracle_excluded_from_benchmark':True}
(r/'oracle_integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
